## Upstream changes v3.8.9 -> v3.8.10

**Verdict:** SAFE TO APPLY — purely additive feature release; the image configurations (user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck, environment) are unchanged between versions, and no companion-service version requirement is introduced.

### Breaking changes
- none found in the notes

### Variables
- none — no renamed, removed or newly required variables. `SIYUAN_ACCESS_AUTH_CODE` / `SIYUAN_AUTH_CODE` continue as already configured in the compose file and `.env.example`.

### Data and dependencies
- none found in the v3.8.10 notes themselves.
- Already true at the current version (v3.8.9), not introduced by this range: that release's own upgrade notice states "Document titles can now include `/`. Use the new version to open and edit these documents. We recommend updating the devices that access the same data and checking that your plugins are compatible, to avoid older versions overwriting your changes." This is a pre-existing condition of the baseline, not a new requirement of this upgrade.
- v3.8.10 continues and extends that same theme ("Support rich document titles and preserve slashes in notebook names") but states no new migration or compatibility step beyond what v3.8.9 already required.

### Before applying
- Take the normal pre-upgrade backup (the `backups` service already does this on its own schedule; confirm a recent successful archive exists before upgrading).
- No manual migration commands or config edits are indicated by the notes.
- Since all devices/plugins touching this workspace should already be on a `/`-in-titles-aware version per the v3.8.9 notice, simply confirm that is still the case before moving further — this is a standing condition, not new work caused by v3.8.10.

- v3.8.10 (2026-11-10) final release notes, plus the superseding rc/beta/alpha pre-releases (v3.8.10-rc.1 through v3.8.10-alpha.1), all of which repeat the same final changelog content.
